question.question: What setback did Melanie face in October 2023?
question.gold: She got hurt and had to take a break from pottery.
question.baseline_note: gate2 improved-defaults local token-F1; fleet config (loco-q2 h3-precedence-timeform) scored 0.0

diagnosis.class: D (retrieval) + G (answer form), compounded by GLM-5.3 helper-budget flakiness
store_evidence: Gold memory EXISTS in the frozen store: melanie_injury_pottery_break_sept_2023 ('On 2023-10-13 Melanie told Caroline she recently had a setback: the previous month (approximately September 2023) she got hurt and had to take a break from pottery') - so NOT class B write-time.

Gold is in the lexical pool: rank 19/115 on the raw question (score 0.5200, the ONLY entry matching 'setback'), but maxRecallEntries=6 cuts it; the question term 'october' never matches gold (content has '2023-10-13', tokenizer keeps hyphenated '2023-10-13' as one token; title says September).

Son-accident decoy: melanie_son_accident_family_roadtrip_october_2023 (reported 2023-10-20, occurred ~2023-10-14/15) matches 'october' + 'melanie' + 'accident'~setback at title weight and wins the window.

When the LLM reranker completes it makes the trap WORSE: it selects ONLY the son-accident id (title-level 'October 2023' match beats gold's '(September 2023)' title) - recall collapses to 1 entry (fleet config attempts: recall_ids=[son_accident] 4/5 times).

GLM-5.3 helper flakiness: distillation (64-token cap) returns empty_output/length ~4/5 runs; expansion (256-token cap) empty/invalid ~3/5; rerank (2048-token cap) invalid_output/length ~1/5 - reasoning burns the caps, so the LLM recall path is a coin flip that never surfaces gold.
Answer-side: the fleet date-only answerInstruction makes the model answer a TIME PHRASE for a what-question ('the weekend before 20 October 2023', F1 0.0).

hypotheses.answer: her son's car accident during a family roadtrip
hypotheses.conclusion: confirms wrong-event recall; rerank used (selected the decoy only); distill+expansion empty_output/length.

hypotheses.desc: query expansion draws 3 (parent hypothesis a; driver clamps draws to 1-3)
hypotheses.conclusion: expansion completed (used, 111 chars) but rerank still selected only the decoy; the date-only answerInstruction then produced a time phrase. Angles cannot fix a rerank filter that sees only titles.

hypotheses.desc: kill the rerank filter + widen the window: recallRerank=false, maxRecallEntries 6->24, maxRecallChars 6000->24000 (parent hypothesis b adapted: pool width was NOT the issue - gold was already in the 200-candidate pool; the rerank filter and the 6-entry window were)
hypotheses.conclusion: RECALL FIXED: gold enters context deterministically at position 19/24 (matches the offline lexical simulation exactly). Answer still wrong-form due to the date-only instruction.

hypotheses.desc: H2 + balanced answerInstruction (event-tolerant: what/who questions get a short factual phrase; the two time-form precedence rules from loco-q2 kept verbatim)
hypotheses.conclusion: distillation coin-flip emitted a truncated fragment that matched 0 entries (used/length, 64-token cap) -> empty recall. Exposes helper nondeterminism, not the instruction.

hypotheses.desc: deterministic recall: recallQueryExtract=true, distillation/expansion/rerank ALL off (no LLM in the recall path) + window 24/24000 + balanced answerInstruction
hypotheses.answer: She got hurt and had to take a break from pottery.
hypotheses.conclusion: WIN: exact gold echo, F1 1.0. Stability 3/3 pass (1.0, 1.0, 0.5556 'An injury that forced her to take a break from pottery').

questions.answer: Freedom and being real - like a nudge to always stay true to herself and embrace her womanhood.

promotion_evidence.claim: The fleet config's LLM recall path cannot fix q135: the reranker sees only titles and the gold title says September, so it actively selects the October decoy; the 6-entry window cuts gold at lexical rank 19; the date-only answerInstruction converts the what-question into a time answer.
promotion_evidence.mechanism: Deterministic single-query lexical recall (extract on, distill/expansion/rerank off) + 24-entry/24000-char window + event-tolerant answer instruction with the loco-q2 time-form precedence preserved.
promotion_evidence.caveat: maxRecallEntries=24 is sized to this store (gold at rank 19/115; window must exceed the gold rank); for stores where gold ranks deeper, the window needs per-store tuning or a temporal-anchor boost (driver has none today - a code-level follow-up).
